post.description: LOCAL CANDIDATE / NOT ACCEPTED. Explicit Clerk v2 RS256 bearer profile, case-sensitive user_/sess_ IDs, authorized party and current provider liveness plus server identity mapping. Existing account is reused; absent mapping creates only an incomplete ungrouped student. Same email/name never links identities. New successful student login supersedes old app family; retired provider sessions cannot reclaim it. No staff entitlement or device policy is inferred. PROVISIONAL / NOT ACCEPTED. Active opaque families require F1 server provenance and an immutable provider binding; missing or unmarked active context fails closed with 503.

Verify raw initData HMAC/freshness/configured bot, consumed409 INIT_DATA_REPLAY, invalid401 INIT_DATA_INVALID, stale401 INIT_DATA_EXPIRED. Fresh login proposed single active family revokes predecessors. Lost response uses existing local session first then fresh launch; reload not guaranteed new initData. No attempt reset.

Opaque body proof distinct from staff SDK. Fixed absolute lifetime, atomic consume+rotation+old access revoke, reuse revokes entire family. Single-flight; lost refresh response no blind retry, fresh Telegram launch. AUTH expiry never restarts or pauses exam.

PROPOSED CONTRACT CHANGE, NOT A BUGFIX: tombstone receipt ACK is limited to a known refresh proof supplied in a schema-valid Logout body with Authorization ABSENT. A known revoked bearer is not a receipt carrier. A supplied bearer must authenticate as a current StudentSession first: malformed/unknown/revoked ->401 SESSION_REVOKED; expired unrevoked access/family ->401 APP_SESSION_EXPIRED; superseded ->401 ACCESS_SUPERSEDED; disabled account ->403 ACCOUNT_DISABLED; missing current student role ->403 FORBIDDEN. Never ignore an invalid bearer to downgrade to body proof. After bearer validation (if present), parse supplied optional body: malformed JSON ->400 MALFORMED_JSON; empty object/null/array/empty or non-string refresh_token/additional fields ->422 VALIDATION_ERROR. No bearer and no body ->401 LOGOUT_PROOF_REQUIRED. Resolve any supplied body proof to retained hashed-proof/family mapping; unknown/unverifiable ->401 REFRESH_INVALID even with a valid bearer. When both supplied, known families must match else401 LOGOUT_PROOF_MISMATCH. For body-only known previously revoked family, check receipt window BEFORE family/refresh expiry: now < retain_until ->200 SuccessAck, including expired family/proof; now >= retain_until ->401 REFRESH_EXPIRED even if physical mappings remain. For known unrevoked body proof, family expiry ->401 REFRESH_EXPIRED with first_revoke remaining null. Current valid bearer-only, valid matching both, or known unrevoked unexpired body proof atomically revoke once and return200 only after commit. first_revoked_at and retain_until are fixed by the first committed revocation and reviewed policy; retries/ACK/policy cutover never extend them. ACK never reactivates sessions, issues tokens or alters exams. retain_until is the logical receipt window end, distinct from purge_not_before. W=24h is an unapproved candidate, not a deployed default. GC must preserve active-family replay and receipt mappings through their reviewed horizons, using the same serialization/locks. Retain hashed proof only; never raw proof in storage/logs. Client body-only receipt requests MUST omit Authorization; local credential clearing without a committed server response is not server ACK. Unknown/lost commit outcome remains uncertain, not a new success claim.

DecimalDisplay2.description: Server final two-decimal nonnegative display from authoritative exact source; HALF_UP candidate requires approval. 0.00 can represent a positive source such as0.004, never input rejection or source rounding.

IanaTimezone.description: Confirmed project examination timezone: Asia/Tashkent (Uzbekistan). Persist IANA name; derive midnight with timezone calendar, never truncate started duration.

Logout.description: Refresh-proof branch only. Required nonempty refresh token when body supplied. Bearer-only logout omits body entirely.

QadamId.description: Permanent external student identifier; preserve leading zeroes. Not authentication or authorization. Server generated, never client assigned.

Recovery.description: Current technical successor START eligibility window. Full duration from pinned version. Closing never truncates a started recovery. No original assignment fallback.

StudentAttemptGradingResult.description: Closed current result with ordinary and separate optional statistical_bonus only. Ordinary stored at completion; bonus never delays or changes it. A cancelled predecessor remains historical/nonofficial. Recovery successor has own ordinary, no inherited old bonus. No active Rasch field or certificate in this contract; historical API is archived separately.

lifecycle_status.description: Required attempt lifecycle, same enum as Attempt.status, independent of score. Only cancelled requires audience-specific cancellation; every other state requires cancellation:null.

StudentAttemptHistoryEntry.description: Chronological history with required lifecycle_status independent of score; existing cancellation condition unchanged. Proposed score:null before a completed result, closed AttemptGradingResult thereafter. Completed submitted/expired/forced requires ordinary via server cross-state invariant; cancelled historical result is never official. Student wrapper/cancellation/result contain no staff IDs, internal reason, keys or peer data. Staff cancellation details remain current scoped staff only.

StudentCancellation.description: Pupil-safe cancellation summary: cancelled_at, prior_status and technical_failure reason_code only. No staff actor identity, internal/free-text reason, audit ID or question/answer content.

StudentCompletedGradingResult.description: Stored non-null ordinary result on submit/force/expiry; optional statistical_bonus is nullable and never delays completion. Lifecycle/cancellation/generation rules retained.
